name: ICM (Intrinsic Curiosity)
tagline: Intrinsic Curiosity Module: a learned forward+inverse dynamics model in a self-supervised feature space; bonus is the forward-prediction error.
formula:
$$\phi_t = \mathrm{Encoder}(o_t),\;\; \hat{\phi}_{t+1} = f_{\text{fwd}}(\phi_t, a_t);\;\; r^{\text{int}}_t = \tfrac{1}{2}\|\hat{\phi}_{t+1} - \phi_{t+1}\|^2$$
$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{ICM}} = \mathrm{CE}\big(f_{\text{inv}}(\phi_t,\phi_{t+1}),\,a_t\big) + 0.2\cdot \tfrac{1}{2}\|\hat{\phi}_{t+1} - \mathrm{sg}(\phi_{t+1})\|^2;\quad A = c_e A^{\text{ext}} + c_i A^{\text{int}}$$
diff_from_baseline: Pathak et al., "Curiosity-driven Exploration by Self-supervised Prediction" (ICML 2017). Learns a feature space invariant to uncontrollable dynamics via the inverse model and uses forward-prediction error in that space as the intrinsic reward.

name: Vanilla PPO (no bonus)
tagline: No-intrinsic baseline: returns zero bonus, returns zero loss for the bonus module, and policy advantage uses only ext_coef * A_ext.
pseudocode:
1. `compute_bonus(obs, next_obs, a) = 0`.
2. `normalize_rollout_rewards(r) = 0`.
3. `loss(...) = 0` (no parameters trained for bonus).
4. `mix_advantages(A_ext, A_int) = ext_coef * A_ext` (A_int is dropped).
5. PPO actor + critic update is the only training signal.
diff_from_baseline: Schulman et al., PPO (2017) on Atari (CleanRL ppo_atari_envpool). Reference comparator with no intrinsic exploration — measures how far policy gradient gets on sparse-reward Atari without any novelty signal.

name: Random Network Distillation
tagline: RND: a fixed random target network and a learned predictor over normalized observations; bonus is the predictor's MSE against the random target.
formula:
$$\phi^\star = T_{\text{rand}}(\bar{o}),\;\; \hat\phi = P_\theta(\bar{o});\quad r^{\text{int}}_t = \tfrac{1}{2}\|\hat\phi(\bar{o}_{t+1}) - \phi^\star(\bar{o}_{t+1})\|_2^2$$
$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{RND}} = \frac{\sum_i m_i\,\mathrm{MSE}(\hat\phi_i, \phi^\star_i)}{\max(1,\sum m_i)},\;\; m_i \sim \mathrm{Bernoulli}(p_{\text{update}})$$
diff_from_baseline: Burda et al., "Exploration by Random Network Distillation" (ICLR 2019). Prediction error of a random target is high on novel observations, providing a stationary, parameter-free novelty signal; CleanRL ppo_rnd_envpool reference implementation.
